messages:
jess-product: quick sync — we need a compact GA checklist for the Tiered Pricing + SLA rollout. goal: ship docs, pricing page, support routing, and basic runbooks by EOW. Who can own which piece?

sam-engineering: happy to own the routing & SLA impl notes. proposal: Hosted = 99.95% availability SLO w/ 5m P95 latency target, Dedicated = 99.9% + capacity guarantees. open to pushback. :thinking_face:

liam-ml: +1 on SLA split. one ask: model-fallback behavior must be explicit in docs (what qualifies as a fallback, expected latency/regression). I'll draft a short table of fallback pairs and quality delta.

maya-ops: runbooks: we need paging thresholds, escalation matrix, and a simple postmortem template. quick alert snippet I propose to include in ops docs:```yaml
alerts:
  - name: inference-errors-high
    condition: rate(errors) > 0.5% for 5m
    severity: page
  - name: high-queue-latency
    condition: p95(latency) > 5s for 3m
    severity: page
```

jess-product: maya — that looks good. Can you add a canary rollback checklist too? one-liner steps we can copy into the README.

maya-ops: yep — will add canary checklist + a one-click fallback note for console.

allen-finance: pricing side note — customers will ask about bill credits for SLA misses. need a formula and a minimum credit cap. recommend: SLA credit = prorated % of monthly invoice up to 50%. Also need clear language for pilot customers vs committed Dedicated customers.

jess-product: allen — can you draft the credit formula text? we'll put in the billing FAQ and legal will review.

liam-ml: docs should include a small experiment section: how to measure quality delta when a fallback occurs (example prompts + expected differences). this helps CS and customer evals.

tess-support: I'll own KB articles and the escalation matrix for Level 1 support. Need model fallback matrix and known-error list from eng. Also please include sample customer wording for support responses.

sam-engineering: re: known errors — I'll export the current incidents list and add to the repo. also adding a short API error contract snippet customers can rely on:```json
{"error": {"code":"RATE_LIMIT","retry_after":30}}
```

oncall-bot: Incident created: #GA-SLA-Readiness (assigned: maya-ops), pinging oncall rotation.

jess-product: summary / action owners: sam = SLA & API error contract, maya = runbooks + alerts + canary checklist, liam = fallback doc + eval prompts, tess = KB & support templates, allen = billing credit language. deliverables due: EOW (Fri COB). ping me if any blocker. :thumbsup:

sam-engineering: noted. I'll add a short PR template for SLA changes so product/legal can approve before merging.

allen-finance: will circulate the billing wording by tomorrow morning.

liam-ml: I'll drop the fallback table and example prompts in the docs repo today.

jess-product: great — once we have PRs we can do a quick shiproom sign-off. thanks everyone! :rocket:
